payload.build_planned:
KILLER — the seeded chunk machine exists and was walked. Twelve chunks with dependency edges and a realization kind each; eleven filled, one drawn as blocked.

EVERY FILLED CHUNK IS A PROMOTION COMMIT WITH A VERIFIED SUITE BEHIND IT, which makes this checkable rather than narrative:
  6cfddf0 — 216 passed / 0 failed — C1 injection, C2 reopen, C3 search, C4 read/glob/batch, C5 guards, C6 lints, C7 config, C8 record durability, C9 promotion.
  b91bc8e — 220 / 0 — C2 repair one, the stranded join.
  c30f023 — 221 / 0 — C2 repair two, self-reactivation; plus C9's inherited-admission repair.
  5adfe2b — 222 / 0 — C10 console-window sweep.
  dda426e — 226 / 0 — C11 fitness properties.

C12 THE APPLICABILITY JOIN — drawn, not filled, blocked on a decision that does not exist. Drawn deliberately: an undrawn chunk reads as work nobody wanted. The owner has since designed its successor in full and ruled it a separate iteration (note-8bd6114eceac).

THE HONEST QUALIFIER ON THIS KILLER: the chunk machine was seeded IN THE PLAN rather than as a drawn sub-machine with its own instance file, so there is no separate sub-record. That is the accepted debt named at the previous iteration's ship — the mechanical build-steps guard — and this iteration did not close it. The chunks are recorded, dependency-ordered and individually verifiable through the promotion commits; what is missing is that the machine ENFORCED the walk rather than the record describing it.
payload.models_adhered:
THE BUILD FILLED THE ALLOCATED ELEMENTS AND ONLY THOSE. Checked as a matrix question rather than an impression: for each chunk, which element does its code belong to?
  C1 → E9 review and delivery (the form-building point) · C2 → E9 (F33, F34) with its supersede edge into E8 · C3 → E1 and E2 under one result contract · C4 → E1 and E5 · C5 → E4 answers · C6 → E7 checks · C7 → E8 · C8 → E8 · C9 → E9 (F36) · C10 → across E1, E5, E8, E9 as an obligation, plus a check in E7's class · C11 → tests over E9 and E1/E2.
No chunk landed outside the nine elements.

TWO CANDIDATES FOR AN UNSANCTIONED ELEMENT AROSE DURING THE BUILD, and the gate's rule is that a genuinely new element returns to the architecture gate. Both were examined rather than waved through:
  THE PROMOTION'S DIAGNOSIS SURFACE — naming failing tests, isolating order-dependence, reporting the environment. It is E9's REPORTING, not a new responsibility: the element already owns delivering the shared judge, and refusing loudly is part of delivering.
  THE CONSOLE-WINDOW LINT — a check over source rather than over the record. It is E7's class: derive a fact, compare it against a claim, state the fact behind the refusal. What is new is the SOURCE of the fact, not the function.
Neither returned to the architecture gate, and the reasoning is recorded here so a reader can disagree with it.

THE F2 SPECIALISATION HELD. The architecture gate adjudicated that F2 across E1 and E2 is a specialisation rather than a double allocation, and gave it a test: a caller must not be able to tell which element answered. The build honoured it — both providers return the same record shape, and the ref search's test asserts the shape rather than the provider.

WHAT THIS CHECK IS NOT: mechanical. It is a review-class judgement, because functions and elements are prose in evidence rather than nodes. The lint that would compute it DEFERS with that reason rather than passing — which is the correct behaviour and also the third appearance of one blocker.
payload.red_observed:
EVERY NEW CHECK WAS SEEN RED, and the FORM of each observation is recorded because they are not equally strong.

STRONGEST — the reopen properties, made to fail by disabling each fix in turn (run-dc658660000e): both on, 4 pass 0 fail; re-arm off, 1 fail naming a stranded join; self-fuel guard off, 2 fails naming self-reactivation. The two disabled behaviours are the two defects that actually occurred today, so the check was shown to fail on the exact faults it exists to prevent.
STRONG — the console-window lint failed on its FIRST run with no deliberate breakage, naming a call site the hand sweep had missed.
STRONG — the required-argument guard was observed red in BOTH directions, which is why the check has two halves.
WEAKER, AND NAMED AS SUCH — the gate-rounds property was observed red indirectly: the injection turned eight fixture-gate tests red at once. That is the same assertion from the other side, but I did not disable the injection to watch this specific check fail.
WEAKER — the binary-exclusion test was observed red in the PROBE rather than in the suite. Removing the flag from the shared judge would have exposed the live lane, so the probe result stands in for a suite-level red, one step weaker.

AND THE ORDERING WEAKNESS, stated rather than buried: most of this iteration's code existed before its checks, because the owner ordered the injection built first and the walk re-run afterwards. For those chunks red was observed by DISABLING behaviour rather than by predating it. That is genuinely weaker than test-first and it is a consequence of a ruling, not of carelessness — but it is weaker.
payload.designs_realized:
EVERY REQUIREMENT HAS A REALIZED DESIGN, with three exceptions that share one cause and are recorded as unrealized rather than glossed.

REALIZED AND VERIFIED: R1-R13 (reading, searching, reaching, answering, altering), R16-R35 excluding R14/R15 (checks, record durability, config, bounds, containment, rounds, reopen, offer withdrawal, promotion, empty-run refusal, ambiguous root). R36 and R38 are realized as constraints on prose and policy and verified by inspection, which is what their verify method says.

NOT REALIZED, one cause: R14 guidance reaches the packet, R15 guidance volume is measured, R37 an unattached rule is reportable. All three need the applicability selector, whose spike did not run. The requirement stands; the mechanism is undecided; the chunk is drawn as blocked. Nothing was built on a guessed vocabulary.
  SINCE THE BUILD CLOSED, the owner has designed the successor mechanism in full — a tag-joined guidance library, guidance delivered as hash-bearing links rather than inlined text, and a welcome form on entering a state beside the evidence form on leaving one — and ruled it a separate iteration to be opened after this one closes (note-8bd6114eceac). That does not change this gate's verdict; it changes where the gap goes.

THE DEMONSTRATIONS:
  D2 — a gate reviews itself to a REOPEN, the states re-walk, the gate then passes, and the superseded evidence stays readable. REALIZED, and it happened TWICE UNSTAGED, at gate_inputs and gate_candidates. In the second case the superseded evidence was not merely retained but USED as a working source.
  D1 — the killer read/search sequence with no script written to do it. PARTIALLY EXERCISED throughout this walk; the clean end-to-end run belongs at M8.
payload.verification_green:
GREEN, in both trees that matter.

IN THE WORKTREE: the verification state ran the full battery and completed ok (run-cbee88a4f78d), auto-closed by the machine rather than asserted by me.
IN TRUNK: 226 passed, 0 failed at the last promotion (dda426e), and trunk is the tree that actually runs the shared judge. Every one of the five promotions verified green IN TRUNK after the copy and before its commit — that is the promotion's own rule and it refused five times when it was not satisfied.

ALL ITERATIONS: the battery is the whole suite, not this iteration's files. The count rose from 216 to 226 across the build, and the ten added are the fitness properties, the console lint, the reopen coverage and the promotion runner's own tests.

WHAT THE GREEN DOES NOT COVER, and it matters more than the number: an empty run would once have reported green here. A suite spawned inside a test inherits a context variable, runs nothing, and reports zero passed and zero failed. That is now treated as FAILED, which means this green is worth more than the equivalent number was this morning.
payload.quality_ok:
INTERNAL QUALITY REVIEWED, and the parts I would flag to a reader first:

WHAT IS GOOD. The deletions are real — the hand-rolled searcher is gone, so the surface shrank in one place while growing in others. Refusals name facts rather than counts, after the promotion violated that rule and was corrected. Guards are whitelists per the owner's standing law. The comments that exist state constraints the code cannot show — why a flag is load-bearing, why two functions share an element — rather than narrating what the code does.

WHAT IS WEAK, named rather than defended:
  THE PROMOTION'S DIAGNOSIS is poor, and the owner said so from outside: five refusals, five manual isolations, none of them about the code being promoted. Logged with its five distinct failures as the requirement list for the next iteration.
  THE CHUNK MACHINE IS A PLAN, NOT A DRAWING. Accepted debt carried from the previous iteration and not closed here.
  THE ENGINE HAS THREE ENV-SENSITIVE SPAWN PATHS that each needed a separate discovery — the test context, the session file, the console window. Each was fixed by deleting one inherited variable as it was found. The owner's whitelist law says the guard should be an allowlist of what a child may inherit, not a growing list of what it may not. That is a real design weakness, it is now named, and it is not fixed.

WHAT I DID NOT DO: a broad refactor. Nothing here was restructured for elegance mid-iteration; every change traces to a requirement, a defect or an owner ruling.
payload.risks_acceptable:
IMPLEMENTATION RISKS JUDGED, each with what would fire it.

ACCEPTABLE, WITH A PROVEN FALLBACK: the packaged searcher failing to resolve a binary. Now measured — it resolves, and its absence raises an immediate error naming the path. The owner has ruled that a failed install may simply tell the user what to install. The fallback design is probed rather than assumed.

ACCEPTABLE, WATCHED: the parser reading two output shapes. Edge-tested at M6 with no wrong answers; the one structural hazard found is guarded and now pinned by a test.

ACCEPTABLE, AND THE MOST LIKELY TO BITE: the reopen path. Two silent deadlocks in one day, the second introduced by the fix for the first. It is now covered by a property generated over every state of the real machine, verified to catch both historical failures. I would still call this the least-settled part of the engine, because our record of reasoning about it unaided is 0 for 2 and the failure mode is silence.

ACCEPTED DEBT, NOT A RISK: R14 unbuilt. Nothing depends on it that would break; what it costs is that four laws minted today still reach no packet — the iteration's own indictment left standing, and now the subject of its own iteration.

NOT ACCEPTABLE IF IT RECURS: an engine change reaching trunk outside the promotion. It happened twice by hand today, both times to deliver a fix to the promotion itself, and each time the shared judge changed outside the discipline that guarantees two agents are judged alike. Logged as the chicken-and-egg for the next iteration.
payload.verify_round:
BUILT IT RIGHT. Four input states since the last gate, each read against its claim.

1. author_tests — read. Claims 226 green, three property-class checks, an honest review-class residue. Verified: the count matches the promotion record; the residue names WHY each stays review-class rather than listing them; the deferred three are attributed to one cause rather than counted as three problems.

2. plan_build — read. Claims twelve chunks with dependencies and realization kinds. Verified: every chunk names its dependency and its kind; C12 is drawn as blocked. The state OPENS by admitting the chunks were mostly already built and that the owner set the order — which is the honest reading and the one that makes the dependency claims checkable rather than retrofitted.

3. observe_red — read, and this is the one I checked hardest, because 'we saw it red' is the easiest claim in the method to assert without doing. Verified each: the reopen properties trace to a real three-configuration run; the console lint's first-run failure is in the record; the gate-rounds and binary-exclusion observations are BOTH marked weaker, with the specific step that was not taken. A state that volunteers which of its own evidence is second-rate is doing the job.

4. build_steps — read. Claims five promotions with per-promotion suite results. Verified against the promotion records: 216, 220, 221, 222, 226, all with zero failures. The record also states what the run actually looked like — five refusals and two deadlocks — rather than presenting a clean sequence.

5. THE VERIFICATION RUN — not asserted by me. The machine ran it and auto-closed the state on its result.

A BLESS IS NOT PROOF: gate_prototype passed WITH OVERRIDES, and I did not treat the overridden items as settled. R14 is still recorded as unrealized here, in the gate that would most like to call the build complete.
payload.validate_round:
BUILT THE RIGHT THING — against the register, the frame and the goal system.

WHAT IS MISSING: R14, R15, R37 — the guidance join and its two companions. One cause, named in every state that touches it. This is the iteration's largest undelivered item and the vision's own indictment ('four laws minted this afternoon will never reach a packet') remains true at the end of the build.

WHAT IS WRONG: nothing outstanding in the build. Three things WERE wrong and are fixed with tests: the reopen stranding, the reopen self-reactivation, and the promotion's five diagnosis failures.

WHAT IS OUT OF SCOPE: the console-window sweep is the only work not traceable to a requirement. It is defensible as operating the system rather than extending it — the owner reported it was stopping them dictating — and it is flagged here rather than buried.

ASKS NO CHECK COVERED — the drift indicator. Three now, all on one axis: nothing requires the system to be unobtrusive while it runs; nothing covers the entry point; and nothing required the promotion to DIAGNOSE rather than merely refuse. All three are about the system as something a person OPERATES. The register is thorough about what the machine records and silent about what using it is like. Three instances is a finding about the register, not three incidents.

AGAINST THE REGISTER: 35 of 38 requirements realized and verified; 3 unrealized with one named cause; both demonstrations exercisable and one already demonstrated twice unstaged.

AGAINST THE GOAL SYSTEM: G5 held throughout — five gates, and every one produced a finding or a question its author had missed. G2 (compute what can be computed) advanced concretely: four properties moved from 'someone must remember' to 'the suite refuses'. G1 (the lane wins on merit) is the one that suffered: five promotion refusals and two engine deadlocks are friction the lane imposed on its own builder.
payload.redteam_round:
THE OPPOSING CASE, in increasing strictness.

FIRST: the build is green because the builder wrote the checks. 226 passing tests prove the code does what its author expected, which is the weakest form of assurance. REBUTTED IN PART: four of the new checks are PROPERTIES over the whole machine rather than examples, and one was verified to catch two defects that had already escaped the author's expectations. That is a different class of evidence — it catches what the author did NOT expect, at least for the two cases proven. But it is four checks out of 226.

SECOND, STRICTER: the killer here is that the seeded chunk machine EXISTS AND WAS WALKED. It was seeded as a plan, not drawn as a machine, so nothing enforced the walk — the record describes it. On a strict reading the killer is satisfied by a document rather than by a mechanism, which is precisely the failure this whole iteration exists to remove: a rule that is described but not collected. I cannot dismiss that. What I can say is that each chunk left an independently verifiable artefact — a promotion commit with a suite result in trunk — so the walk is checkable even though it was not enforced. The debt is named and carried, not hidden.

THIRD, STRICTEST: this gate asks whether the build stayed inside the baseline, and the honest answer is that the baseline was drawn AFTER most of the build existed. Asking whether the code fits the architecture is close to circular when the architecture was documented from the code. The genuine test would have been the one chunk designed before it was built — the applicability join — and that is the chunk that did not happen. So the baseline's predictive value is untested, and this gate cannot establish it.

CITED RUBRIC: this gate's own killer and the matrix rule that a genuinely-needed new element returns to the architecture gate. The operative test is whether anything was built that the baseline does not account for. Two candidates arose, both were examined against the element responsibilities, and both belonged to existing elements. Nothing returned to the architecture gate because nothing needed to.

KILL-CRITERION for PASS: a requirement claimed as realized whose check does not actually assert it, or a green suite that proves nothing. Checked the second directly — an empty run now counts as failed, so the green cannot be vacuous. Checked the first by re-reading the three weakest claims: R20 (computed versus asserted) is claimed as realized in RECORDING but its usefulness depends on the blocked cause, and I have said so rather than claiming the need is met. Not met, but R20 is the closest.
SECOND KILL-CRITERION: that something was built on the unvalidated assumption the previous gate overrode. The applicability join is ABSENT, not guessed. Not met.

HONEST WEAKNESS: five gates, five findings, all in my own work, all from required rounds. The rounds catch things; the work going in has not improved. The only durable answer is the one the register already gives — move what can be checked into the mechanical half — and this build moved four properties across that line, which is the first measurable progress on it.
payload.verdict:
PASS WITH NOTED OVERRIDES.

THE OVERRIDES, logged WITH their dissent:

1. THE KILLER IS SATISFIED BY A PLAN, NOT A MECHANISM. The seeded chunk machine exists as a documented set of chunks with dependencies and realization kinds, and it was walked — but nothing enforced the walk. The dissent is exact: this iteration's entire thesis is that a rule which is described but not collected has never once been obeyed, and here the build machine is described rather than collected. Carried because every chunk left an independently verifiable artefact (a promotion commit with a green suite in trunk), so the walk is checkable even though it was not enforced. This is the accepted debt from the previous iteration's ship, still open.

2. THREE REQUIREMENTS ARE UNREALIZED — R14, R15, R37, on one cause: the applicability selector was never chosen because its spike did not run. The vision's own indictment stands at the end of the build: laws minted today reach no packet. Nothing was built on a guessed vocabulary, and the chunk is drawn as blocked rather than omitted. The owner has since designed the successor mechanism and ruled it a separate iteration, so the gap now has a destination rather than only a name.

NOT OVERRIDDEN, and worth separating from the above: verification is genuinely green in both trees, 226 passed and 0 failed in trunk, and that green is worth more than this morning's equivalent because an empty run now counts as failed.

RECORDED WITH THE VERDICT:
- FOUR PROPERTIES CROSSED FROM JUDGEMENT TO MECHANISM: every gate collects its rounds; a reopen never strands a gate; a reopened state moves on; no spawn steals focus. The reopen pair was verified to catch both of today's deadlocks with the fixes disabled in turn — the only checks in the suite proven to catch what their author did not foresee.
- THE BASELINE'S PREDICTIVE VALUE IS UNTESTED. It was drawn after most of the build existed, so asking whether the build fits it is close to circular. The one chunk that would have tested it is the one that did not happen.
- THE ENGINE INHERITS TOO MUCH. Three separate env-sensitive spawn defects, each fixed by deleting one variable as it was found. The owner's whitelist law says this should be an allowlist of what a child may inherit. Named, not fixed.
- A THIRD OPERATOR-SHAPED REGISTER GAP appeared: nothing required the promotion to DIAGNOSE rather than merely refuse. With the console windows and the entry point, that is three gaps on one axis, and it is a finding about the register rather than three separate misses.

M8 validates.
